mentl/d349199:
mentl query <file> "cost" reports modules linked, source lines
processed, and nodes minted — the weave's own NModule cells and
graph_next(), never a clock. That distinction is the whole point. A wall
time is a host fact that varies per run, so it can be reported and never
ratcheted; these three are identical every run.

So the frontier now holds the prelude floor as a contract.
tests/frontier/mn-bare-floor.mn is a bare fn main() = 7 whose entire
cost — 7 modules, 6304 source lines — is vocabulary the medium processes
to answer nothing, and the leg refuses a rise. Monotone down; what
lowers it is link-is-reachability. Both halves were seen red:
unknown-query against the prior boot, and the real 6304 against a
deliberately under-set ceiling.

module_paths became module_cells (path + span), with the paths and the
line extent as two projections of one walk rather than a second walk for
the second fact.

This also retracts the previous pin. That entry claimed the compile is
quadratic in module count, fitted on four points spanning N=7..22, and
convicted the env. Its own named probe refuted it: eight entries
spanning N=6..54 and 6.3k..58k DAG lines show cost per line moving 1.7x
where cost per module moves 2.0x, and the quadratic predicted main at
22.0s where it measures 12.05s. The compile is linear in the source it
processes, ~150us a line. The new facet confirms it from an independent
deterministic channel: 10.7 to 12.2 nodes minted per source line across
the same range.

The method lesson is the durable half. Four points over a 3x range
fitted a curve a 7.7x range destroyed; a fit is a hypothesis until it
predicts a point outside the range it was fitted on.
mentl/d3722ab:
A String is now a stride-1 byte list end to end. TString unifies with
[byte] in unify_types (nullary, no alias clone; a generic element binds
TByte); the physical record is the unified [count][tag_word][bytes@+8]
(literals via the emit's 8-byte header, every builder through bytes_buf,
io/net/json/lsp_frame/persist/driver/main off the +4 layout); byte_at IS
list_index, ++ IS the O(1) concat node, str_slice IS the slice node; the
sign-bit view machinery is deleted (view_base -> str_payload, the
stride-normalizing materialization boundary).

TByte~TInt is check-level value-equality (same_ground, never a binding):
datum-last inference types map's lambda while its param is still free,
so operator-scoped directional widening could never fire on the flagship
map((b) => b - 32, s). The slot is guarded where slots live — the
carrier on reads, store_strided's 0..255 range trap on writes,
construction from the result type, stride normalization at boundaries.
unify_types gains its missing TByte scalar arm (the catch-all had been
refusing Byte vs Byte). list_to_flat splits to two altitudes (a typed
[a] -> [a] table entry over flat_raw): that one root was the entire
13-entry libs-isolation shadow, now empty. str_concat_all is the
two-pass N-ary packer (the right-fold form stack-exhausted, measured).

Landed via a two-stage disposable ladder: boot compiled W1 (old layout +
new compiler) to m2; m2 compiled the real tree to m3 == m4 == m5
byte-identical — m3 == m4 directly, so the migration is
behavior-preserving for the compiler's own computation. W1 is discarded;
zero permanent compat. The nine-fixture behavioral battery joins the
frontier gate, RED-first under the pre-merge boot (15 refusals). Board
at pin: census 0, frontier 116/0, proof-exactness 9/9, crown 5/5,
micros 72/72, phantoms 287 -> 286.

mentl/d33638a:
An eight-agent adversarial pass refuted six claims of the fusion synthesis I
had reasoned to inline (Morgan's own DX-first framing among them), and the
surviving form is sharper and more honest. Crystallize it into the north star.

The equivocation cut first: 'the proof becomes the dispatch' is a total
function at instruction-selection (an f64 operand admits one add opcode) but
only a monotone FILTER at authorship, where a type-plus-refinement is a partial
spec admitting infinitely many well-typed inhabitants. So the medium does not
author by proof and does not cut out the proposer; it makes the sieve cheap,
sound, and universal over every proposer, and the dispatch among survivors --
which proven program the developer meant -- stays exogenous, carried by the
human or a learned ranker that is itself a Synth handler behind the gate. This
is Oracle-Guided / Synthesis-Modulo-Oracles instantiated on the memory model,
not a new architecture.

The causality was a telos-as-arche error. The generative root is the kernel
and its closure !Outside; both the felt developer experience and the five
machine-age properties project from it, and the developer is the telos the
medium serves -- which is exactly why proof wins over convenience. DX and the
machine-age trust gap are the same Carried-Truth invariant at two scales;
re-rooting on either dissolves the convergence argument the north star rests
on. Scope !Outside as toolchain reflexivity, not a closure of the intent space
(specs are born in the head) or the capability space (Rice).

IFC is !Flow, the crown applied to data flow, with two co-equal regimes:
developer confidentiality/integrity in trusted code, and adversarial integrity
in agentic systems -- the latter the adversary specification that forces the
hardest requirements and the actual adoption pull, not a footnote. Retire the
hype vocabulary, not the regime.

Trustworthiness is a conjunction with a dependency order -- compiler
correctness beneath, Verify-discharge sound

two-top/d318ea8:
Release version bump for v1.0.0-rc1. SIM_VERSION goes from the u32::MAX dev
sentinel to 1 — so replays recorded by the release binary carry a real version
and old/foreign-version replays are routed to their tagged binary rather than
silently loaded into different sim semantics.

The load-bearing detail: `canonical_replay()` was stamping `DEV_SIM_VERSION`,
but the committed demo is the one replay that's encoded to a file and
*strict-decoded* across binaries (replay_sync/replay_viewer check it against
`sim::SIM_VERSION`). Left as-is, a SIM_VERSION=1 binary would reject the
u32::MAX-stamped demo. Fixed by stamping `sim::SIM_VERSION` in the canonical
generator; the in-process test/fuzz replays keep `DEV_SIM_VERSION` because they
feed `Replay` structs directly (no version check), so they're unaffected.

Regenerated tests/demos/canonical/match_v1.bmrg (14418 bytes, now stamping
sim_version=1; the 4-byte shrink is exactly the u32::MAX→1 varint). Gate: 370
tests (canonical pipeline green), clippy --all-targets clean, sync_test 600
frames no desync (position bits unchanged — the stamp doesn't touch sim
behavior), fuzz clean across 8 seeds spanning all three arenas.
tokensafe/d3c4ccc:
Degraded tokens (e.g. TRUMP) previously scored 0/LOW when checks failed,
giving bots false confidence on incomplete analysis. Three root causes
fixed:

1. Uncertainty penalties: when checks fail even after fallbacks, apply
   honest scoring (+10 top_holders/liquidity/honeypot, +5 token_age,
   +3 metadata). Max uncertainty = 38 → MODERATE, not CRITICAL.

2. Data recovery fallbacks:
   - Top holders: Helius DAS getTokenAccounts (3 pages, 3000 accounts)
     when getTokenLargestAccounts throws "Too many accounts"
   - Liquidity: DexScreener API fallback catches CLMM-only pools,
     Jupiter timeouts/429s
   - Token age: limit 100→1000 sigs for accurate creation time

3. Lite/MCP response enriched with degraded_checks[], checks_completed,
   checks_total so agents can see what data is missing.

386 tests (was 369), all passing. No breaking schema changes.
noodles/d34ebe7:
The qblink class flipped on #session twice a beat for as long as the
transport ran, queued or not, and a class flip on the grid container
invalidates every descendant that any .qblink selector can reach.
Nothing was queued for almost all of that. Measured by deleting the
two .qblink rules in-page at 4x throttle: 4-12 ms/s of style work
back during plain playback. The toggle now forces false when no track
is queued (removing an absent class costs nothing), and the blink
still lands on the quarter note the moment a queue exists — the lag
probe's queued check sees the ring, the on phase, and the off phase.
